free_tier.stated: Homepage headline: 'Your free and unlimited file storage'. No numeric total quota published anywhere on the site.

egress.terms: Free downloads capped ~5 GB/day at roughly 55-60 KB/s; Turbo 40 GB/day, 600 GB/month. No per-GB charge.

tooling: Same Turbobit-family stack (Uploader app, FTP). No documented public API.
chaining: Sister host of Turbobit with the same 'unlimited volume' claim; chain = N email accounts, serving bounded by per-IP/day caps.
limits_note: Per-file cap not published on the pages read (unverified). Retention ends on 'storage time expiration'. Free speed ~55-60 KB/s, one download per IP with queueing.
reliability_note: Blog/inventory claim only — 'unlimited' is a headline, with no docs page stating it and no per-file number anywhere. Treat the quota as unverified.

evidence.proved: 'In free mode, however, the maximum file download is approximately 55-60 Kbytes/s'; Turbo 40 GB/day, 600 GB/month
'storage time expiration' listed as a removal reason; no per-file cap stated (unverified: not published)
